specs.title: the empty home and its footer pass accessibility checks in both modes
every page links only to pages that load whole, under the base, from this origin
an anchor link lands on its heading, Chinese ones included
an address with nothing behind it is a real 404 that looks like the site, at any depth
the policy arrives as a header where the host can send one, and in every page
a directory without its slash is redirected, and nothing outside the base is served
the first frame follows the system, and a stored choice before any paint
the switch changes, marks and keeps the mode across pages
refused storage leaves the system mode and a switch that still works
copy hands over the block's text exactly and says so
a refused clipboard says so and selects the code for copying by hand
a code group shows one tab, switches its namesakes and remembers across pages
highlighting spans stay inline, block scopes included
the sidebar marks the page, and the contents follow the reader to the last section
on a phone the menu and the contents are panels that close on a link and on Escape
the columns follow the width, and nothing scrolls sideways down to 320 px or at 200 %
are in the header from 768 px and in a row of their own below, marking the guide
a heading id with % neither breaks the contents nor the narrow menus
an SVG symbol keeps its fragment, and a class's background loads from the site
everything reads, every code tab is shown and nothing pretends to be a control
one h1, landmarks and the page's language
